reviewer: Kimi main recovery executor actually viewed the exact 65x67 source and its NEAREST 8x review detail, complete unchanged current raw, previous rejected raw, full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha comparison sheet, native cap/frame and note regions, and the unchanged naiwa reference. Verified current evidence/source/output/task/prompt/request/result/sheet and original-task recovery bindings with read-only Python.

remaining_reasons: The source faces viewer right toward the note: its mouth/nose mass is on the right of the face and the larger near eye is on viewer left. External-05 instead places the mouth on the left of the face with the small far eye on viewer left and larger near eye on viewer right, retaining a viewer-left orientation. Restore the source's viewer-right pose/gaze, with larger near eye on viewer left, small far eye on viewer right and mouth mass toward the note.

The source has separated irregular gray-mark groups inside its two compact upper note rows. External-05 collapses them into two long uniform horizontal bars, one per row, losing the separated group construction. Restore the source's separated irregular groups within the original compact two-row footprint, not readable writing, while retaining the blank lower note and small dark right-edge tab.

hair_features.reason: Dark brows and a clean-shaven face remain; the hairline is cap-covered and no glasses or beard was added.

collar_fit.reason: The red standing collar fits the short broad neck with no pinched or floating collar and no cream bib.

entries.positive_observation: The latest raw has a compact yellow mascot with green-ringed black eyes, dark brows, one closed mouth and no human skin, nose or ears. The cap now sits inside a continuous sloping upper photographic frame rail, correcting the earlier cap/frame overlap. The dark olive uniform, gold-embroidered red collar tabs, dark backplate, blank lower note and small right-edge tab remain. White/cyan/alpha viewing shows no visible interior hole or lost backing; these correct properties do not offset the remaining pose and note-group defects.
entries.alpha_decision: The native RGBA has extrema [0,254]; internal near-opacity is not itself a rejection ground. White/cyan viewing shows genuine exterior transparency and no visible interior holes or working-matte halo. The cap/frame exterior is improved, but the visible RGB pose and note-group defects still require a new art repair; this is not approved for alpha-only replacement or production.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine cap/collar insignia and note glyph identities are unreadable at 65x67. The rejection is instead based on the clearly visible orientation and the replacement of multiple separated gray-mark groups by two uniform bars, not on guessed writing or tiny embroidery.
